light_description: Highly tweakable op-amp distortion with independent bass, mid and treble controls and five clipping voices ranging from smoother compressed gain to more open high-output distortion.
Flexible overdrive capable of clean boost, natural singing drive and mid-gain distortion, with active bass and treble controls, clean blend and Smooth/Crunch voicings.
Green Russian Muff-inspired fuzz with expanded EQ, clean blend and Classic/Modern modes for vintage-style growl through a more open higher-output voice.
Ram's Head-inspired fuzz with increased gain and sustain, mid control, clean blend and Classic/Modern voicings.
Hybrid fuzzstortion combining thick fuzz saturation with distortion-oriented gain for aggressive, sustained dirt textures.
Product family entry retained as a catalog-level reference for the documented Green Russian and Ram's Head versions; individual variants are recorded separately above.
Single-control power-amp-style distortion designed for crushing grind, extended low end and sharp upper harmonics, equally suited to guitar, bass and preamp-style use.
High-gain overdrive based around a DOD 250-style gain stage with active two-band tone shaping and extended low-end control.
High-gain fuzz designed for thick, saturated and sustaining tones with the aggressive character associated with the FW70 series.
Octave fuzz combining saturated fuzz with upper-octave harmonics for aggressive, dense lead and riff textures.
Heavy fuzz built for dense saturation, sustain and a large low-end response.
Aggressive distortion designed for heavy, sustained gain and dense wall-of-sound textures.
High-gain distortion with a reinforced low end, aggressive mid control and a clean-blend facility that can preserve note articulation under extreme gain.
Massive three-band distortion with a switchable dirty octave boost, moving from gritty overdrive into saturated heavy gain while retaining strong note attack.
High-gain amplifier-style distortion with independent presence and three-band EQ plus a switchable boost circuit for aggressive, saturated riff tones.
Amplifier-inspired preamp and gain pedal intended to recreate the drive and feel of a high-powered tube-style circuit.
Boost pedal with octave-oriented harmonic enhancement for pushing an amplifier or adding upper-harmonic density.
Germanium boost designed to add gain, upper-frequency focus and amplifier drive ahead of the main dirt stage.
Current version of the 1312 distortion family, retaining the builder's compact high-gain distortion format.
Dual-channel 1312 platform combining two distortion stages for stacked and higher-gain applications.
Aggressive dirt pedal from the Black Mass lineup, presented in standard and large-format versions for dense saturated gain.
Large-format version of The First Herald, documenting the separately catalogued enclosure presentation of the same product family.
Current Black Mass distortion model with a forceful high-gain character and compact pedal format.
High-gain Black Mass dirt pedal built around an aggressive, saturated response.
Dense fuzz/distortion pedal with a switchable low-end character, moving from a standard fuzz setting into an unusually large low-frequency fuzz voice.
Compact boost designed to buffer and push the guitar signal for added presence and level.
Full-size analog fuzz pedal from the current Teisco line, aimed at saturated fuzz tones and expressive harmonic texture.
Full-size overdrive pedal providing a compact modern drive voice in Teisco's current pedal line.
Full-size distortion pedal offering higher-gain saturation in Teisco's current pedal line.
Mini-format boost pedal designed to add signal level and tonal push in a compact enclosure.
Mini-format overdrive voiced for blues-oriented amplifier breakup and responsive drive.
Mini-format vintage-voiced distortion pedal for classic saturated gain textures.
Mini-format transparent D-style overdrive with tight response, rich harmonics and suitability for both stacking and standalone crunch.
Mini-format high-gain distortion with fast attack, tight low end and switchable EQ voicings for heavier riffing.
Mini-format fuzz pedal focused on saturated lead textures and synth-like upper harmonics.
Tube Screamer-style overdrive pedal designed around familiar mid-focused clipping and amplifier-pushing drive.
High-gain distortion built for aggressive, saturated guitar tones and forceful riff response.
Fuzz pedal providing thick saturated gain and sustained fuzz textures.
